crossRefs.note: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you…
He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse…
He said, “You are blessed by Yahweh, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning…
Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”

translations.web: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”
translations.bsb: “Come, you who are blessed by the LORD,” said Laban. “Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels.”
translations.kjv: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
translations.asv: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of Jehovah. Wherefore standest thou without? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
